Frontend UI verified via Playwright: Admin Invoices tab shows 4 stat cards (Invoices=4 / Total Sales=$358 / Commission=$35.80 / Unpaid=$20.90), commission rate input, 'All invoices' filter dropdown, Regenerate button, 4 invoice rows with eye icon + Mark Paid/Mark Unpaid (Mark Paid click flips status and persists after reload). Detail modal opens on eye click. Seller Invoices tab shows 4 rows with Amount Owed stat card + OWED column. issues: Table header uses 'OWED' instead of 'Amount Owed' — requirement said 'Amount Owed column'; the AMOUNT OWED stat card is labeled correctly. Minor cosmetic inconsistency only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1346 lines — still a single-file monolith. Strong recommendation to split into routers/ (auth, shops, products, restaurants, menu, orders, favorites, settings, admin, invoices, seeding) before iter4 or maintainability will degrade.

_rebuild_invoices() does a full delete_many + re-insert every call. For the demo it's fine, but under load this would thrash. Consider an upsert by (seller_id, shop_id, week_start) key so id/created_at/status auto-preserve without the current two-pass 'existing' dict.

Invoice endpoints use 'Paid'/'Unpaid' literal strings without an enum constant — grep shows it's hard-coded in 5+ places including InvoiceStatusIn, admin_list_invoices q-filter, and seed. Extract a constant to avoid typos.

Admin commission-rate input has no upper/lower bound validation on the backend (commission_rate: Optional[float]). A seller could theoretically be charged 200% if rate=2.0 is set. Add 0<=rate<=1 Pydantic validator.
SellerDashboard.jsx is now 854 lines with 5 big components (ShopsTab, ProductsTab, InvoicesTab, OrdersTab, SettingsTab) — should be split into pages/seller/*.jsx files, each <300 lines.

AdminInvoicesTab: the numeric commission rate input accepts rate >1 silently. UI should clamp to [0,1] and show '%' representation (10% vs 0.1). Currently showing 'Commission 0.1 (10.0%)' is ambiguous to non-technical admins.
Table header in Seller Invoices uses 'OWED' while the stat card uses 'AMOUNT OWED' — minor copy inconsistency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all iter3 critical flows tested

seed_data_creation: None — relied on 4 auto-seeded invoices (1 Paid + 3 Unpaid) from seed orders spanning 3 weeks. Each test cleaned up TEST_-prefixed products/menu-items it created and reverted commission_rate to 0.10.
